decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (2015(AR)07-01 - A, 2015(AR)03-03 - A, 2015(AR)07-02 - A. Received: 07/12/2015) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The windows formed in the side and rear elevations shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 259 Hounslow Road. It shall also never be used in conjunction with activities associated with primary living accomodation such as bedroom, bathroom, W/C or kitchen.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the any elevations or roof of the outbuilding hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the outbuilding without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Retrospective application for erection of a single storey outbuilding at the rear garden of the house
